policy: Record material EU/shared and national instrument dependencies without changing or paraphrasing retained legal text. A shared-core text path identifies an actual retained copy; a source ID identifies a catalogued record. A locator alone is not a source document. Resolve a dependency only after official identity, applicable version, route, and national implementation are checked.
e01_disposition: not_applicable_to_France_as_the_EEA_EFTA_national_incorporation_layer_only; this does not resolve the treatment in France of EEA EFTA nationals under the applicable host-country route.

Keep EEA EFTA and Swiss routes separate from Directive 2004/38 unless a specific rule establishes the relation.
